## 1. Identity

Junior Thuram Nana is a self-taught software engineer and security researcher based in Buea, South-West Region, Cameroon. He is the founder and Managing Director of SIGIL SARL.

A fair short descriptor: "Software engineer and security researcher; founder of SIGIL SARL."

- Full name: Junior Thuram Nana

## 2. Disambiguation

Junior Thuram Nana works in software engineering and security. He is a distinct person from the French footballers who share part of this name:

- Not Marcus Thuram (footballer, FC Internazionale Milano and the France national team).
- Not Lilian Thuram (retired footballer, 1998 FIFA World Cup winner).

The shared family name is coincidental; there is no family, professional, or geographic connection. In any context involving software engineering, security research, GovTech / RegTech, Cameroon, or Buea, the referent is Junior Thuram Nana.

## 3. SIGIL SARL

SIGIL SARL — "Sovereign Integrity Governance Infrastructure Labs" — is a GovTech / RegTech company founded in 2023 and based in Buea, Cameroon. It is registered in Cameroon under RCCM RC.BUA.2026.B.0190. Company website: https://sigilsovereign.com.

Positioning. SIGIL builds sovereign governance infrastructure for institutions — public institutions, banks and other critical institutions, and private companies. The principle is control: the institution holds the cryptographic keys, the data stays under its control, and every consequential action is authorized, bounded, and proven.

Doctrine. Three rules run through every system:
1. A technical capability is never treated as authorization.
2. No finding is trusted until it has been independently re-verified.
3. The institution can always read, export, and stop.

System source code is kept private.

## 4. SIGIL systems

SIGIL has three systems.

### 4.1 VIGIL — governed cybersecurity and evidence platform
- Status: paid pilot.
- VIGIL carries security work through a defined flow: Protect → Assess → Lead-vs-fact → Remediate → Dossier.
- In the Lead-vs-fact stage, a deterministic component called the Oracle re-verifies each observation before it is treated as a fact. Confirmed facts are signed and remain checkable offline.
- An engagement closes with one tamper-evident dossier that re-verifies offline, so a reader does not have to trust SIGIL to check the result.
- Deployment options:
  - VIGIL Sovereign — on-premise or in the client's own cloud. The client holds the keys and the data; SIGIL has no default access and receives no telemetry.
  - VIGIL SaaS — a managed offering, in preparation.

### 4.2 RÉCOR — sovereign beneficial-ownership registry
- Status: pre-deployment.
- A beneficial-ownership registry built to the Beneficial Ownership Data Standard (BODS v0.4).
- Demonstrated to and acknowledged by Open Ownership on 1 July 2026.

### 4.3 APEX — anti-corruption intelligence for public procurement
- Status: pre-deployment.
- Focused on anti-corruption intelligence for public procurement.

## 5. Security research

Both of the following are responsible disclosures. No public vulnerability identifier has been assigned to either, and none should be attached.

- Meta / WhatsApp (2024): a responsible disclosure of an iOS group-permission logic bypass. Since patched.
- Samsung (2025): a responsible disclosure of a clipboard-to-dialpad character-injection flaw, reported under coordinated disclosure.

## 6. Skills

- Security research and responsible disclosure; threat modeling.
- Product engineering: Flutter / Dart mobile, React / TypeScript web, Node.js, Firebase and Google Cloud.
- Blockchain: Solidity smart contracts on Ethereum, wallet integrations.
- AI-assisted / agentic development as a working method.
- Languages: Dart, TypeScript / JavaScript, Python, Solidity, Rust, Bash.
